name: Pole Banner Set – Double-Sided Custom Vinyl Banners with Mounting Hardware
descriptionHtml:
Promote your brand with maximum visibility using our Pole Banner Set, designed for street poles, light posts, and outdoor installations. These double-sided banners deliver high-impact messaging from both directions, making them ideal for storefronts, downtown promotions, campuses, events, and municipal branding.

Each banner is printed front and back at high resolution (720 × 720 DPI) on durable 18 oz. blockout vinyl, ensuring vibrant graphics with zero show-through. The set includes all required hardware, allowing for quick and secure installation on poles up to 12 inches in diameter.

Built for long-term outdoor use, the banners are waterproof, UV safe, and can include wind slits to extend lifespan in high-wind environments. Reinforced construction and quality materials ensure a clean, professional display that lasts.

🔹 Key Features

🏙️ Pole Banner Set – Designed for street poles and light posts
📐 Banner Width – 24 inches wide
🔁 Double-Sided Graphics – One banner printed front & back
🎨 High-Resolution Printing – Digitally printed at 720 × 720 DPI
💪 Heavy-Duty Hardware Included –
• 2 Fiberglass Arms
• 2 Mounting Brackets
• 4 Steel Bands
🌦️ Outdoor-Ready – Waterproof & UV safe
💨 Wind Slits Available – Optional for increased durability
🔩 Brass Grommets – One on each corner for added strength
🧵 Reinforced Construction –
• No hems
• Double-stitched pole pockets (top & bottom)
📏 Pole Compatibility – Metal cable tie fits poles up to 12" diameter
🪢 Steel Bands Length – 40" long

🔹 Material Option

🧱 Banner Material: 18 oz. Blockout Vinyl

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ High-Resolution Digital Printing (720 × 720 DPI)

🔹 Artwork Setup Guidelines

How to set up your artwork for the Pole Banner Set:

📐 Your submitted graphic must match the exact print dimensions ordered.
🪜 There are 2-inch pole pockets at the top and bottom of the banner.
⚠️ The seams from the hemmed pole pockets will be visible 2 inches from the top and bottom of the graphic—please keep important content clear of this area.

🔹 What’s Included

📦 1× Double-Sided Pole Banner (Front & Back Printed)
🦾 2× Fiberglass Arms
🧱 2× Mounting Brackets
🪢 4× Steel Bands

🔹 Primary Usage

Street poles, light posts, downtown banners, storefr
